hypotheses: The source definition is the weak subgroup-intersection RWPRI condition; flag transitivity, residual connectedness and even the full geometry axiom are not hypotheses of this target.
All parabolic groups are standard simple subfield Suzuki groups.
scope.contradiction: The source uses four distinct prime divisors and permits pure-subfield Construction 11 only through rank three. The actual rank-four pregeometry has all sixteen distinct intersections and all thirty-two required prime-degree maximal inclusions. Constructions 1–10 each require a soluble maximal parabolic, so they do not cover it.
qualifications: This is the literal endpoint omission; adding appropriate truncations or changing a rank range might repair it, but no complete repair is claimed.
No geometry or flag-transitivity claim about this rank-four example is used.
The standard-subfield intersection lemma is acquired by L114; the two source dispositions remain distinct.
common_qualifications: Each disposition refutes the literal fixed published assertion, rather than recovering every true result in that paper.
Classical Suzuki matrix, Bruhat, order, subfield-maximality and stated torus or automorphism facts remain explicitly attributed inputs; no new classification of Suzuki groups is claimed.
The older phase6/phase8 witness and proof history is preserved without a new-discovery or priority claim.
